name: News Arcade
description: RSS headlines in the NBA / NFL / NHL Live arcade style, as a continuous ticker: every story scrolls right to left on one strip (round-robin across feeds, so nothing is cut off and several stories are always on the way), a logo tile that follows the story at the edge, and a BREAKING burst when a feed publishes a new top story. A failing feed keeps its last headlines. Set layout to cards for the older one-story-at-a-time screens. Replaces the news ticker.
author: ant456

versions.notes: Continuous ticker layout (default): all headlines scroll on one strip instead of one cut-off headline at a time; smaller default font (6x10) and faster scroll; BREAKING burst stays up long enough to read the headline; new layout option (ticker or cards).
First release: arcade headline screens, single-pass crawl, BREAKING burst, round-robin feeds, feed logos.
